import math

def check_condition(q):
    target = q*q - q + 1
    # Find the cube root
    p_float = target**(1/3)
    p_int = round(p_float)
    
    # Check if it is a perfect cube
    if p_int**3 == target:
        p = p_int
        # Check if p is prime and p != q
        if p > 1 and p != q and is_prime(p):
            return True, p
        else:
            return False, p
    return False, None

def is_prime(n):
    if n <= 1: return False
    if n <= 3: return True
    if n % 2 == 0 or n % 3 == 0: return False
    i = 5
    while i * i <= n:
        if n % i == 0 or n % (i + 2) == 0:
            return False
        i += 6
    return True

primes_to_test = [23, 29, 31, 37]
results = {}
for q in primes_to_test:
    success, p = check_condition(q)
    results[q] = (success, p)

print(results)
